lines.text: Nehemiah the governor, son of Hacaliah, was named first among the sealers, then the priests, Levites and leaders.
The rest of the people and their families swore an oath to follow the Law of God given through Joshua.
They promised not to marry their daughters to the people of the land, or take theirs for their sons.
They would not buy from the land's people on the Sabbath, and would cancel debts every tenth year.
They pledged a third of a shekel yearly, wood, firstfruits and tithes, so they would not neglect God's house.
